title: Scheduling Order and Notice of Virtual Hearing (Docket No. 26-2664-01)
text:
- BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION OF UTAH - 

Application of Thirty-Two Hundred 
Homeowners Association for a Certificate 
of Public Convenience and Necessity for a 
Water Corporation to Provide Water 
Services within the State of Utah 

DOCKET NO. 26-2664-01 

SCHEDULING ORDER AND NOTICE OF 
VIRTUAL HEARING 

ISSUED: April 24, 2026 

At the scheduling conference the Public Service Commission (PSC) held on 
April 21, 2026, the parties in attendance agreed to the following schedule, which the 
PSC approves and adopts: 
SCHEDULE 
ITEM 
DEADLINE/DATE/TIME/LOCATION 
Initial Comments, Non-Applicant 
Tuesday, May 26, 2026 
Intervention Deadline 
Tuesday, June 2, 2026 
Reply Comments 
Tuesday, June 9, 2026 
Virtual Hearing 
Tuesday, June 16, 2026, beginning at 
10:00 a.m. via Google Meet at: 
meet.google.com/rhn-ybms-izc 

DISCOVERY 
Discovery turn-around times shall be 14 calendar days up to and including May 
26, 2026, and 7 calendar days thereafter. Parties shall serve discovery requests and 
responses on applicable parties by electronic mail. In the event a document produced 
in response to a discovery request cannot reasonably be transmitted by electronic 
mail, the party disclosing the document shall provide an electronic copy of the 
document on CD (or, if an electronic copy is not available, a paper copy). 
DOCKET NO. 26-2664-01 

- 2 - 

NOTICE OF VIRTUAL HEARING 

The PSC will conduct a hearing on interim rates in this docket on Tuesday, June 
16, 2026, beginning at 10:00 a.m. The hearing will be conducted via Google Meet at the 
following link: (meet.google.com/rhn-ybms-izc). All parties must have their witnesses 
in attendance and prepared to testify. 

The PSC requests that attorneys and witnesses make themselves available by 
both video and audio during the portions of the hearing in which they will be actively 
participating. Participants are free to deactivate video, and should always mute audio, 
when not actively participating. In the event of unresolvable technological problems 
related to the hearing’s video conferencing, participants should use the following 
audio-only participation information: 413-276-6157 PIN: 366 803 402#. 

Individuals needing accommodations during the hearing should notify the PSC 
at 160 East 300 South, Salt Lake City, Utah 84111, (801) 530-6716, at least three 
working days prior to the hearing. 

DOCKET NO. 26-2664-01
